findings.claim: At DAC 2026, all three EDA leaders shipped agentic chip-design stacks: Cadence presented the AuraStack AI Super Agent for PCB and advanced packaging (cited up to 20x faster multiphysics performance) and positioned its four agents, including ChipStack for verification, as a complete silicon-to-system agentic stack; Siemens announced self-verifying agentic workflows in Fuse EDA AI Agent (cited more than 10x faster library characterization); Synopsys announced its own agent portfolio. Futurum's read is that all three are shipping toward the same destination on NVIDIA's stack, with NVIDIA and AMD as lead customers pulling the roadmaps.
findings.source: Futurum Group, 'Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens Take Agentic Chip Design Autonomous at DAC' — https://futurumgroup.com/insights/synopsys-cadence-and-siemens-take-agentic-chip-design-autonomous-at-dac/

findings.claim: At DAC 2026, Synopsys introduced a fully autonomous design verification agent that it says gives up to 50x faster time-to-validated RTL and 20% additional coverage improvement, plus the first autonomous EDA workflows on Microsoft Discovery with AMD (25-40% reduction in debug cycle time). These are the vendor's own claims as reported by Futurum, not independent benchmarks.
findings.source: Futurum Group, 'Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens Take Agentic Chip Design Autonomous at DAC' — https://futurumgroup.com/insights/synopsys-cadence-and-siemens-take-agentic-chip-design-autonomous-at-dac/

competitive_share_entrants.note: No verified statement of share gain or loss vs Synopsys/Siemens in 2026 was found, so share direction is unresolved. Search-summary claims that Cadence is 'taking share in all major segments' and 'pulling ahead of Synopsys organically' could not be traced to a page: the tikr.com 2026-05-08 article was fetched and does not contain them, so they were not used. Search summaries also mentioned a new entrant, Ricursive Intelligence (AlphaChip co-creators, doing placement itself), and a Futurum TSMC-symposium item saying only Synopsys announced COUPE-specific enablement; neither had a page date or verified text, so both were left out of findings and are leads for a later pass. 2024 vendor-share numbers (31/30/13) also had no attributable source or date and are not included. Article dated 2026-07-29; page shows 2026-08-05 as publication date, and the earlier date is used as as_of.
